property_summary: After a depositor has withdrawn all credit, a subsequent withdrawAll must be a harmless no-op that does not revert (credit was reset); the mutant fails to reset credit, so the second withdrawal underflows `balance` and reverts.
change_summary: Delete the statement `credit[msg.sender]=0;` so credit is never reset after withdrawal, allowing repeated withdrawals of the same credit and leaving different state after withdrawAll.
